title: Lionel Messi reflects on his time at Barcelona: ‘Difficult to summarise in a few words what it means’
tweet: Messi accepted the 2026 Princess of Asturias Award and said Barça remains part of his life, recalling the privilege of sharing the dressing room with Xavi, Iniesta and Puyol – a sentiment that also touched his late father, who was thrilled by the honor. The award, he added, goes beyond the field, echoing his father's lesson to never stop trying.

title: Barcelona playmaker’s remarkable run ends after a fresh injury against PSG
tweet: Olmo to miss Real Madrid after an adductor tear that ends his 44‑match consecutive appearance streak for Barça. As things stand, his absence will force Flick to reshuffle the attack during a critical stretch of the campaign.

title: Barcelona begin renewal talks with young midfielder despite lack of minutes under Flick
tweet: Barcelona have begun talks to extend Brian Farinas’ contract through 2029 or 2030. The 20‑year‑old has yet to make a competitive appearance, so his lack of minutes may force a decision in January. As things stand, the club is hedging its investment while keeping the option to adjust if his playing time remains limited.

title: Liverpool increasingly likely to pay €55 million for Ronald Araujo as Barcelona loanee impresses
tweet: £55 million purchase option for Araujo sits on the table. If his form at Anfield stays consistent, Liverpool are increasingly likely to exercise it, though the decision will hinge on long‑term value.

title: Barcelona players hype up upcoming clash against Real Madrid: ‘Huge challenge and the biggest motivation’
tweet: Barcelona’s first loss to PSG snapped a 12‑game streak, but the squad quickly refocused on the Clasico, calling it a huge challenge and the biggest motivation. The game is seen as a reset that could cement early LaLiga momentum.

title: Barcelona see former club captain as future first-team manager with Deco left impressed
tweet: Busquets’ coaching stint at Barça Atletic has convinced Deco and Krkic that he could be a future first‑team manager, but a role would only materialise in five or six years if his progress remains steady.

title: Joao Cancelo hits back at critics after Barcelona’s defeat to PSG: ‘From the stands everyone is an expert’
tweet: Joao Cancelo’s Instagram story after the 4‑2 loss to PSG reminds critics that “from the stands everyone is an expert.” The Portuguese full‑back’s post comes just before the next high‑pressure match with Real Madrid, where he will need to prove his defensive reliability on the pitch rather than in commentary.

title: Barcelona hopeful versatile star can return for El Clasico against Real Madrid
tweet: Barcelona are working to have Kounde available for the Clasico; his inclusion depends on how quickly the ankle sprain heals, so a squad spot is plausible but a start is uncertain.

title: Five players who can emerge as unlikely heroes in Barcelona vs Real Madrid
tweet: Barcelona will need a surprise lift; Espart can turn defence into attack, Valverde’s versatility will test Cancelo, Adeyemi’s pace could spark the counter, Espi’s lethal finish will keep the pressure on, and Jesus’ clinical touch offers a late goal threat.
